findings.summary: Env-var, file, default and Sources values bypass the custom separator config because FlagBase.PostParse calls f.Set without a cmd, so setMultiValueParsingConfig is never applied and values are split on the default separators.

Subcommands no longer inherit SliceFlagSeparator, DisableSliceFlagSeparator and MapFlagKeyValueSeparator from parent commands, since only the owning command's settings are read (previously process-global), also affecting persistent flags parsed by a child.
disableSliceFlagSeparator is now an untyped const that is dead in non-test code, so the flag_test.go test using it does not exercise the disable path; use explicit true/false or delete it.
flagSplitMultiValues uses else after a return, which a linter will flag.
